description:
## Outcome

        Each case result and run artifact states what execution policy was requested, what trusted profile was resolved, and what the backend confirmed. Missing facts never appear as enforced facts.

        ## Why now

        Constrained execution is not auditable until its confirmed facts cross the stable `jido.case-result` boundary.

        ## Current state

        `Result.new/2` has dimensions, sources, execution, evaluation, turns, usage, and error. The manifest has runtime versions and source digests. Neither contains profile identity, binding fingerprint, backend, isolation, network, workspace, image digest, limits, checkpoint, or cleanup facts.

        ## Ownership and boundary

        This is a `jido_cli` schema and presentation change. Consume only the public redacted Jidoka projection. JSONL remains the external boundary and the only stdout writer. Jidoka remains the source of confirmed facts.

        ## Detailed implementation

        1. Extend the validated case-result schema with an additive versioned `execution_environment` object or make a documented v2 migration. Prefer an additive v1 field only if the compatibility rule from the schema story permits it.
2. Include status, requested profile/capability IDs, resolved profile ID/digest, binding fingerprint, and confirmed backend, isolation, network, workspace, image digest, limits, checkpoint, restore/fork, close, and cleanup facts.
3. Use explicit states such as `not_requested`, `rejected`, `open_failed`, `enforced`, `closed`, and `cleanup_failed`.
4. Add stable profile and policy digests to the manifest, never raw host configuration.
5. Include the final evidence in `results.jsonl` and by-agent artifacts through the same record.
6. Redact credentials, commands, host paths, adapter options, and provider-private metadata.
7. Keep diagnostics on stderr and assertion/execution exit rules unchanged.

        ## Acceptance criteria

        - [ ] Requested, resolved, and confirmed sections are distinct.
- [ ] A requested guarantee with no confirmation is marked unknown or rejected, never enforced.
- [ ] Backend, isolation, network, workspace, image digest, limits, checkpoint, and cleanup facts appear when confirmed.
- [ ] No secret, raw command, mount, host config, handle, or temporary provider path appears.
- [ ] Unprofiled cells have a small stable `not_requested` value.
- [ ] Every stdout line remains one valid case record and statuses remain 0/1/64.

        ## Test plan

        - Success: full deterministic evidence, partial supported evidence, and unprofiled cell.
- Invalid input: malformed Jidoka evidence is converted to a valid execution error, not emitted.
- Runtime failure: open, policy, checkpoint, close, and cleanup failures preserve requested and confirmed prefixes.
- Boundary and security: nested secret redaction and no raw provider values.
- Deterministic capability: fixed profile digests, adapter evidence, clocks, and IDs.
- JSONL and exit status: exact one-line JSONL, manifest/result cross-reference, artifact copies, stderr separation, and 0/1/64.

        ## Documentation

        Update the output contract with the exact field table, schema compatibility rule, evidence meanings, and redaction guarantees.

        ## Non-goals

        Do not report inferred enforcement. Do not add a comparison score. Do not change assertion policy. Do not expose raw adapter responses.

        ## Dependencies

        Blocking issues:

        - `jido_cli-tqg.3.7` — Run each automation cell in one constrained environment
- `jido_cli-tqg.2.3` — Validate case results, manifests, and run summaries

        Features unlocked by this story:

        - Auditable constrained coding runs
- Replay provenance
- Limit and cleanup reporting

        ## Commit plan

        Create exactly one focused `jido_cli` commit. Use a message such as `feat(cli): publish constrained-execution evidence (jido_cli-tqg.3.8)`. Do not include another backlog feature.

        ## Verification commands

        ```sh
        cd /Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_cli/jido_cli
mix test test/jido_cli/cli/automation/result_test.exs test/jido_cli/cli/automation/jsonl_test.exs test/jido_cli/cli/automation_test.exs
mix quality
mix test --cover
mix docs
        ```
title: Publish requested and confirmed enforcement evidence
